# Columns are the tab-separated `tbl`, `idx`, `stat` projection of
# `sqlite_stat1`. An empty `idx` is the table's own rowid statistics.
# Captured 2026-09-04 from workspace builds of the corpus clones under
# each analyzed with `PRAGMA analysis_limit = 1000; ANALYZE;`. Where the
# stores disagreed about one index, the row with the largest first count
# (the estimated row total) was kept, so the fixture models the largest
# table the corpus produced rather than an average.
